summary: The largest and most templated of the three. The safety framing is mostly right: medicines, vitamins, cleaners and fuel stay high-shelf and grown-up, kidney beans are tinned, the spread never names its brand, the hip flask holds cocoa, and the pill bottle's raccoon Legendary is a good joke. Two drink Commons slip, though: x_wine and x_beer read as real alcohol and are rewritten as grape juice and ginger beer. Elsewhere the writing is very thin: Rares are the object's job, Epics are queues and crowds, and Legendaries are quiet 'for forty years' successes (all 126 names are 'The X That Y'). A dozen objects repeat one trait across every rarity (rolling chickpeas and meatballs, peanut-butter glue, thick milkshake). Several pairs are near copies (gas cylinder and propane tank, ketchup and ketchup bottle, honey and honey jar). The move set has heat names on cold drinks, garbled 'Crunch Stink' nut poisons, unsafe kit defaults ('Fizz Spray' on bleach and fuel) and 58 Ultimates that repeat the Epic. Fresh replacements are given for every high and medium item, and all of them were verified (length, ASCII, uniqueness across every curated file and the Pilot 01 proposal).

patterns.pattern: Rare is the object doing its job ('smells so good', 'pours so fast', 'makes the bathroom sparkle', 'so moreish'): 102 of 126 Rares are flagged.

Legendaries are quiet successes or the years formula ('for forty years', 'a whole summer', 'which is a record', 'which nobody believes'; 117 of 126 flagged); all 126 Legendary names are 'The X That Y'. Epics are mostly crowd scenes and queues.
patterns.suggestion: Replacements given for every listed line. After the name swaps 'The X That' drops to 7 of 126. Only 5 of 126 replacement Legendaries are cosmic.

patterns.pattern: One trait across all five rarities: chickpeas and meatball (rolling), peanut butter (glue), milkshake (too thick), cashew (picked first), fish fillet (flakes), bacon (the smell wakes the house), chicken wing (sauce and napkins), jar (the stuck lid), body wash and dish soap (bubbles), flour and cocoa (powder clouds), peanut (shells).
patterns.suggestion: Replacements give each rarity its own premise.

patterns.pattern: Heat signatures on cold or non-hot things: 'Fizz Heat' (cola, soda), 'Cool Sip Heat', 'Cool Pour Heat', 'Cold Shake Heat' (they contradict themselves), 'Sticky Heat' (honey, jam, peanut butter, maple syrup), 'Creamy Heat' (hummus, mayonnaise), 'Fruity Heat', 'Pearl Heat', 'Pop Heat', 'Rattle Heat', 'Red Stain Heat', 'Sweet Sip Heat'. Garbled poison names on nuts and seeds: 'Crunch Stink', 'Shell Stink', 'Smile Stink', 'Roll Stink', 'Seed Stink'.
patterns.suggestion: Truthful heat images are given (ginger, chilli, hot cocoa, boiling jam). Nut poison names become rancid or stale smells.

patterns.pattern: Kit defaults that are wrong or unsafe: 'Fizz Spray' on bleach, the gas can and the jerry can (a spray of bleach or fuel); 'Brain Freeze' and 'Fizz Burst' on hot tea and hot chocolate; 'Claw Pinch' on sushi, fish fillet and mussel; 'Spicy Kick' on baby food and essential oil.
patterns.suggestion: Rename these kit slots for these objects (names given).

patterns.pattern: Ultimate repeats or contains the Epic name in 58 objects (Highchair Hurl, Halftime Squirt, Honeypot Raid, Caught Red-Handed, Bottle Bank Clatter, Sushi Conveyor, Chip Shop Splurt, Washing Up Bubbles, Too Much Salt).
patterns.suggestion: Each finisher gets its own image; varied Ultimates are effect-neutral.

patterns.pattern: Same-object pairs written as near copies: x_gas_cylinder and x_propane_tank (heavy, by the barbecue, runs out halfway, two people carry it); ketchup and ketchup bottle; honey and honey jar; coffee bag and coffee beans; vinegar and vinegar bottle; spice jar and spices; wine bottle and wine glass bottle; ink bottle and w20 fountain pen ink; milkshake, milkshake glass and smoothie; pill bottle and vitamin bottle (the childproof cap); beer can and w20 soup can (the snapping ring pull).
patterns.suggestion: Split given per pair: gas cylinder = barbecue, propane = camping; ketchup = slap and splat, bottle = squeeze and splutter; honey = pour, honey jar = dipper and bees.

patterns.pattern: Sensitive objects. Alcohol: x_wine C ('a drink that grown-ups swirl') and x_beer C ('a foam moustache on grown-ups') read as real alcohol, so they become grape juice and ginger beer. Dares: x_hot_sauce (a spicy challenge, 'only the bravest') invites kids to copy. Animal harm: spray_bottle R sprays the cat, x_glass_cleaner R has birds flying into windows. Unsafe pictures: bleach and fuel kits named 'Fizz Spray'; x_mussel R reads as cooking advice. Handled well and kept: medicine, pill and vitamin bottles stay high-shelf and grown-up; cleaners and fuel cans stay grown-up; kidney beans are tinned only; the spread (x_nutella) never names its brand; hip flask holds cocoa; no ingestion jokes.
patterns.suggestion: Replacements given; they keep the grown-up-only framing everywhere.
